set.body: The isolated unified MVPA gate passes but emits four JVM and four Scala.js deprecation warnings from DataSelection.scala points -> indices and DatasetAcquisitionDomain.scala TotalMap.at -> apply / FiniteDomain.pointOption -> indexOption. Acceptance: migrate to current dependency APIs with JVM+JS behavior tests and restore a warning-clean gate without compatibility aliases.
set.title: Remove dataset selection deprecations exposed by the MVPA gate
